texto: The contract distinguishes the start and the duration, sets a payment deadline and leaves a doubt about when the notice period begins.
The language task is to identify what the text establishes and formulate a question about what it does not clarify; do not assume which of the two dates applies.

frases.alumno: The contract takes effect on 1 June for twelve months, and payment must be made by the fifth day of each month at the latest.
